podcast.body: Her fourth album, released in 2021, marked a shift towards a pop-punk style, featuring collaboration with Travis Barker of Blink-182. "For her fourth album in 2021, she switched things up a bit into a more pop punk vein with help from Travis Barker of Blink 182."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This album features Willow Smith's pop punk catalog, including the song "Transparent Soul," and was released on Jay-Z's Roc Nation label. "Willow Smith and part of her pop punk catalog from the album Lately I Feel Everything, which was released on Jay-Z's Rock Nation label."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
